# Phoneme audio attribution

These source-verified phonetic recordings are stored locally so the child's critical stop-consonant practice does not depend on remote URLs or general TTS.

- `phoneme_t.ogg` — *Voiceless alveolar plosive.ogg*, Wikimedia Commons. Current source describes isolated IPA [t]. License listed by Commons: CC BY-SA 3.0 / GFDL. Source page: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Voiceless_alveolar_plosive.ogg
- `phoneme_p.ogg` — *Voiceless bilabial plosive.ogg*, Wikimedia Commons. Source describes isolated IPA [p]. License listed by Commons: CC BY-SA 3.0 / GFDL. Source page: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Voiceless_bilabial_plosive.ogg

These are phonetic reference recordings. `phoneme-audio.js` records source verification separately from any later educator/parent listening review.
